blocks.content: CIC handles complaints and second appeals related to Central Public Authorities. State-level matters are handled by State Information Commissions.
CIC handles complaints and second appeals related to Central Public Authorities.

rows: Complaints and Second Appeals at the Central Level
Complaints and Second Appeals at the State Level

items: Second appeals for Central Public Authorities lie with the Central Information Commission (CIC), not State Commissions.
State Information Commissions exclusively handle state-level matters and cannot adjudicate on Central Public Authorities.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Information Commission (CIC) exercises jurisdiction over complaints and second appeals involving Central Public Authorities.
Matters pertaining to state-level public authorities fall under the purview of respective State Information Commissions.
Jurisdiction is functionally divided between Central and State levels based on the governing public authority.
